text: GraphQL API lets you request exactly the fields you need, nothing more
quote: The Fireflies API is built on top of GraphQL... This API allows you to retrieve exactly the data you need in a structured format.

text: Self-serve API key generation from the Integrations settings page
quote: Navigate to the Integrations section 3. Click on Fireflies API 4. Copy and store your API key securely

text: API authenticates requests via standard bearer token in Authorization header
quote: We use a standard bearer token authentication mechanism. This means that to make authorized requests to the API, you must include an `Authorization` header with a valid token.

text: uploadAudio mutation lets you upload audio files for transcription via API
quote: The `uploadAudio` mutation allows you to upload audio files to Fireflies.ai for transcription.

text: transcripts query fetches a list of transcripts matching input filters
quote: The transcripts query is designed to fetch a list of transcripts against input arguments.

text: transcript query fetches full details for a specific transcript by ID
quote: The transcript query is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript ID.

text: Official MCP server lets AI tools search and retrieve Fireflies documentation
quote: The Fireflies Documentation MCP Server enables AI tools to search and retrieve information directly from the Fireflies documentation.

text: Fireflies data can be queried directly through ChatGPT's Deep Research feature via integration
quote: Once connected, you can query your Fireflies data directly through ChatGPT's Deep Research feature.

text: Bot can be invited to a live meeting or auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe, summarize
quote: Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.

text: Detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries generated instantly after each meeting
quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.

text: Automatically detects and switches languages between meetings
quote: Automatically switch languages from meeting to meeting with ease.

text: Identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files
quote: Fireflies identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files.

text: Automatically records Google Meet calls with real-time transcripts
quote: Automatically record your Google Meet calls and get real-time transcripts.

text: Audit logs available via the API for tracking activity
quote: Audit Logs ([API](https://docs.fireflies.ai/graphql-api/query/audit-events#audit-events))

text: Rules Engine gives admins automation workflows to control meeting access and privacy
quote:
Rules Engine

Automation workflows for admins to have control over meeting access and privacy.

text: AskFred is a built-in AI assistant users can query
quote: AskFred: AI assistant

text: Enterprise Private Storage lets orgs choose where meeting data is stored
quote: Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.

text: Secure dedicated cloud storage exclusively for an organization's data
quote: Secure, dedicated cloud storage exclusively for your organization’s data.

text: Can ask AI to compare call objections across customer segments (e.g. Enterprise vs SMB) over a time period
quote: Compare the objections mentioned in calls with Enterprise prospects versus SMB prospects this quarter

text: Super Admin role grants full meeting access across the entire workspace
quote: Full meeting access to your entire workspace by upgrading to Super Admin status.

text: Conversation intelligence with team analytics available for admins
quote:
Conversation intelligence

Team analytics (for admins)

text: API can filter meetings by an array of attendee email addresses
quote: Filter meetings that contain any of these emails as attendees. Accepts an array of email addresses.

text: Fireflies can connect to ChatGPT via OAuth without requiring API keys
quote: You can now connect Fireflies to ChatGPT using our OAuth integration—no API keys required.
